title: 第5章 抽象的合欢宗第6章 离谱门规
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第5章抽象的合欢宗“褚璃，你骗走我的元阳，必须负责！”
山门前，一位高大俊朗的白衣修士红着眼控诉面前的红衣女子。
“道友，那日双修本就是你情我愿，何来骗字一说？
若人人都像你这般，我合欢宗岂不坏了规矩？”
女子高挑玲珑，容貌不是绝顶出尘，但乌黑明亮的眼睛像是会说话，朱唇如她身上的红衣般热情如火，可道出的话却如冰锥刺骨。
男子身形摇晃，但仍不死心。
“我只是想与你结为道侣，不会干涉你与别人双修，如果可以，我愿意做你的炉鼎。”
男子声音悲切，欲扯住褚璃的衣袖，祈求她的怜爱。
“三、二……”
有人开始倒数，听得云洛有些摸不着头脑。
直到人群突然让开一条道，一团不明物如流星般倒飞出去，速度快到只在空中留下一道雪白的残影。
山门前，哪还有什么白衣修士。
“这个月第七个了。”
“哎，真是的，咱们合欢宗什么规矩这些人还不知道吗？”
“跟个狗皮膏药似的。”
“唉，为什么这些男人都喜欢找合欢宗的的人负责呢？”
“恐怕是看我们合欢宗富裕，想要入赘当凤凰男。”
众人七嘴八舌，直到有弟子看到穆荷，这才噤了声。
“见过惊鸿长老。”
众弟子纷纷行礼，待穆荷点头后陆续离开。

“师父！”
褚璃见到穆荷，忙上前，看到一旁的云洛，又是眼前一亮。
“这就是小师妹？”
穆荷早在回来的路上就将云洛的事情告知她们三人，所以她知道自己多了个师妹。
褚璃弯腰，双手捧着云洛的脸，云洛闻到她身上好闻的气息。
云洛婴儿肥的脸被挤成包子，含糊道∶“二师姐好。”
她方才听到对方的名字了。
“啊啊啊，太可爱了，终于又多一个新鲜的师妹了。”
“你看着好小啊，今年多大了？想练剑还是炼丹？要不和我一起画符……”
她一连问了许多问题，云洛一一回答。
穆荷见二人还算和睦，放下心来。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Abstract Hehuan Sect "Chu Li, you defrauded me of my Yuanyang, you must be responsible!"
In front of the mountain gate, a tall and handsome monk in white clothes complained with red eyes to the woman in red clothes in front of him.
"Fellow Taoist, that day of double cultivation was originally a matter of love between you and me, so how could you lie about it?
If everyone is like you, wouldn’t our Hehuan Sect break the rules? "
The woman is tall and exquisite, and her appearance is not extraordinary, but her dark and bright eyes seem to be able to speak, and her red lips are as passionate as the red dress on her body, but the words she speaks are as piercing as ice picks.
The man's body was shaking, but he still didn't give up.
"I just want to become a Taoist companion with you and will not interfere with your dual cultivation with others. If possible, I am willing to be your cauldron."
The man's voice was sad, and he wanted to grab Chu Li's sleeves and pray for her love.
"Three, two..."
Someone started counting down, which made Yunluo confused.
Until the crowd suddenly made a way, an unknown object flew out like a meteor, so fast that it only left a white afterimage in the sky.
In front of the mountain gate, there are no monks in white.
"This is the seventh time this month."
"Hey, really, don't these people know the rules of our Hehuan Sect?"
"It's like a dog-skin plaster."
"Hey, why do these men like to find people from the Hehuan Sect to take responsibility for?"
"I'm afraid it's because our Hehuan Sect is rich and wants to become a Phoenix man."
Everyone was talking at random, until one of the disciples saw Mu He, they fell silent.
"I've met Elder Jinghong."
All the disciples saluted one after another and left one after another after Mu He nodded.
"Master!"
When Chu Li saw Mu He, he hurriedly stepped forward. When he saw Yun Luo beside him, his eyes lit up again.
"Is this my junior sister?"
Mu He had informed the three of them about Yun Luo on the way back, so she knew she had an extra junior sister.
Chu Li bent down and held Yun Luo's face with both hands. Yun Luo smelled the good smell on her body.
Yunluo's baby-fat face was squeezed into a bun, and he said vaguely: "Hello, Second Senior Sister."
She just heard the other person's name.
"Ahhhh, it's so cute. Finally, we have a new junior sister."
"You look so young. How old are you this year? Do you want to practice swordsmanship or alchemy? Why don't you draw talismans with me..."
She asked many questions in succession, and Yunluo answered them one by one.
Mu He felt relieved when he saw that the two of them were on good terms.
